notes: This file externalizes the Streamlit page workflow mapping that was previously hard-coded inside pages/0_0_Streamlit_Page_Workflow.py. It is intentionally human-editable and serves as the canonical registry for page->RQ->artifact relationships.

pages.label: Bulk OCR
pages.purpose: Upload or select sustainability reports and convert them into OCR markdown, page artifacts, images, and source JSON.
pages.use_when: You need source text, OCR outputs, provenance, or evidence that report PDFs were converted into usable text.

pages.label: OCR Company Metadata Labeler
pages.purpose: Assign company names and sector/subsector/industry/subindustry metadata to OCR document folders.
pages.use_when: You need document-to-company provenance before extraction, visualization, or company-level analysis.

pages.label: LLM Processing
pages.purpose: Run prompt/model extraction over OCR text to produce ESG ABSA records.
pages.use_when: You need to generate or expand records, rebalance prompts, rerun social-pillar pages, or add matched model runs.

pages.label: Ground Truth
pages.purpose: Manage or create human-labeled ground-truth data for validation.
pages.use_when: You need expert labels, annotation samples, or data for precision/recall/F1.

pages.label: Streamlit Page Workflow
pages.purpose: Navigation hub that maps every Streamlit page to research questions (RQs), artifacts, and thesis chapters.
pages.use_when: Start here when writing, validating, or defending the thesis; use it to decide which page proves what.

pages.label: Research Questions Dashboard
pages.purpose: Thesis-facing evidence matrix and narrative scaffolding that connects results to Chapters 4–6.
pages.use_when: You need chapter-ready tables/figures and a single place to justify claims and limitations.

RQ1.question: How can sustainability reports be transformed into structured ESG evidence?
RQ1.goal: Prove the PDF/OCR-to-structured-record pipeline works and is traceable.

steps.why: Convert PDFs into OCR markdown/images and preserve provenance.
Extract structured ESG ABSA records from OCR text.
Inspect parsed outputs and confirm record fields exist.
Ground extracted statements back to source pages.
Present traceability evidence for the thesis.
Write Chapter 4.1 results and cite artifacts.

RQ2.question: How should ESG be categorized by aspect, pillar, sentiment, and tone?
RQ2.goal: Show taxonomy + distributions, then validate with expert labels.

steps.why: Expose tone/pillar/aspect distributions and proxy checks.
Trace aspects into ontology paths and quantify coverage.
Create expert labels for downstream metrics.

key_artifacts.meaning: Thesis-ready tables/CSVs and ontology artifacts used across analysis and chapter integration.
